description:
Hexcells Infinite is a deterministic minesweeper puzzle game. 
If you like Minesweeper, but hate guessing, this is the game for you.

1.3.0.description:
# Changelog
- Handle collected levels (eg. other game goaled or used `/collect`).
  - Collected levels are marked as completed and don't have to be cleared to goal.
    - The old behaviour can be used by enabling the "Require Clearing Collected Levels" option.
- Death link (optional)
  - Making a mistake sends a death link. Getting sent a death link restarts the current level.
  - Amnesty can be configured to only send a death link every X mistakes.
- When completing a level, show the item that was sent (instead of just "Check sent").
- Update level select after being sent an item. Previously, seeing unlocked levels would require entering and exiting a level to refresh.
- Fix gem count update on initial load (when starting the game after having been already sent a gem).
- Fix level completed message being displayed above the fade-to-white.
- Log any connection error messages in `BepInEx/LogOutput.log`.
- Include manifest file so the AP world won't break with Archipelago 0.7.0 (unless there are other breaking changes).

# Known Issues
- Death link received/sent messages are not displayed when using vanilla levels. (The death link itself still works.)
- TLS handshake fails.
1.3.0.title: Hexcells Infinite Randomizer for Archipelago 1.3.0

1.3.2.description:
# Changelog
- Fixed missing error message when failing to connect to Archipelago.
- Changed save file name from `slotAP.save` to `slotAP_{seed}.save`. There is no longer any need to delete the old save file before connecting to a new multiworld.
- Adjusted the message when finding your own item.

# Known Issues
- Death link received/sent messages are not displayed when using vanilla levels. (The death link itself still works.)
